title: Fixed cost changes the local unit-cost calculation
method: Synthetic monthly cost = 2,400 fixed + 0.002 × accepted requests. Divide by accepted requests: 2,600/100,000 = 0.026 and 3,200/400,000 = 0.008. Assumptions are illustrative; failed-work cost, redundancy and actual operations must be included in a real model.
alt: Fixed cost changes the local unit-cost calculation. 100,000 requests: 0.026 assumed USD per accepted request, 400,000 requests: 0.008 assumed USD per accepted request. Illustrative data.
